roleTitle: Business Intelligence Engineer, Treasury Management Platform
jobDescription: The treasury management platform of a corporate bank reports cash positions and liquidity metrics to treasury desks. The Business Intelligence Engineer owns the liquidity reporting suite end-to-end, decides the release of each report version to the desks, leads the reporting change board, and is accountable to the head of treasury technology for report accuracy. The suite serves four treasury desks and the group liquidity function, and the role works with the platform team that owns the source feeds and with the desk heads who consume the reports.
requirements: Owns the liquidity reporting suite end-to-end and decides the release of each report version to the treasury desks.
Builds and maintains the reporting data models and the report layer.
Leads the reporting change board with the desks and records decisions.
Coordinates data-source changes with the platform team and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents known limitations and hand-over conditions for each report release.

evidence.text: Owned the liquidity reporting suite for the treasury desks for three years: I decided and executed the release of each report version to the desks, as the named product owner for the suite in the treasury technology register.
Built and maintained the reporting data models (SQL Server, SSAS) and the report layer (Power BI) for intraday cash positions and liquidity ratios.
Led the monthly reporting change board with the desk heads, deciding which change requests were scheduled and recording the decisions in the change-board minutes.
Coordinated data-source changes with the platform team through the platform change process, recording that the platform team owned the source feeds while I owned the reporting models and releases.
Responsibilities included suite ownership, release decisions, data-model and report development and the change board for treasury liquidity reporting over about three years.

Work sample: the treasury technology register entry naming the candidate as product owner, the release log for the suite and one change-board minute, with the reporting platform's release identifiers as a verification trail.
Reference call with the former head of treasury technology: confirmed the candidate was the registered product owner, decided the report releases and led the change board; confirmed employment dates.
Recruiter logistics note: candidate is available for a reporting walkthrough on site and has a two-month notice period.
